Job Title: Software Developer
Department: Engineering
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka (Hybrid)

About the Role
We are looking for a Software Developer to join our backend team and help build scalable APIs for our e-commerce platform.

REQUIREMENTS
- 2-4 years of experience in backend development
- Strong knowledge of Java or Python
- Experience with REST APIs and microservices
- Familiarity with SQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL)
- Working knowledge of AWS or similar cloud platforms
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Design and build backend services and APIs
- Write clean, tested, maintainable code
- Collaborate with frontend and product teams
- Participate in code reviews

NICE TO HAVE
- Experience with Docker
- Exposure to Agile/Scrum practices
